name: What preparation is needed before Hometelligent Inc. installs new window trim?
description: Before installation, clear the work area around your windows by removing furniture and belongings to ensure clear access for our team.

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before Hometelligent Inc. installs new window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before Hometelligent Inc. begins installing new window trim, we ask that you clear the work area around your windows, both inside and out, removing any furniture, curtains, or personal items. This provides our installers with unobstructed access and helps protect your belongings. We will cover floors and adjacent surfaces to minimize dust and debris, but ensuring the space is ready upon our arrival helps streamline the process. If you have specific concerns, please discuss them with our team.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, clear the work area around your windows by removing furniture and belongings to ensure clear access for our team.
